subject: Request: demo window buffer + credit buffer while connector rollout is paused
messages:
From: Diego Rios <diego.rios@novusinsights.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya@novusinsights.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — deployment connector teething issues

Hi Mina / Marcus,

Quick update from our side — the cloud connector that streams customer data into the sandbox bump is failing intermittently when the payload includes nested attachments. Engineering traced it to our schema translation layer; we're blocked until Wednesday when the infra team can deploy a fix.

This puts us in a bad spot for the scheduled demo window (June 24-25). Given the delay, can Redwood extend our sandbox window and add a small credit buffer so we can complete a full end-to-end run without being squeezed by throttle limits? Our CTO (Priya) is looped — this POC is timeboxed and we'd rather not have to push the decision deadline.

I've attached a short log excerpt that reproduces the failure. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Diego
Senior Platform Engineer
Novus Insights

Attachments: integration_log_excerpt.txt (text)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Rios <diego.rios@novusinsights.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priya Sethi <priya@novusinsights.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — deployment connector teething issues

Diego — thanks for the log and the clarity. Sorry you're stalled; I can imagine how frustrating this is with a demo looming.

Quickly from our side:
- We can extend your sandbox access by 7 days and apply a 15% credit buffer to cover the extra token usage while you re-run the integration tests.
- I need a short internal approval (Marcus) for the buffer; the extension I can grant immediately.

Marcus — can you OK the 15% buffer for Novus (DEAL-4821)? If you prefer, I can route this through pre-approved POC exceptions but I'd like to keep this simple for Novus.

Diego / Priya — if you can send a quick milestone plan with the expected fix window and target retest times, we'll lock the extension and credit. A one-page milestone is sufficient.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Diego Rios <diego.rios@novusinsights.com>, Priya Sethi <priya@novusinsights.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — deployment connector teething issues

Mina — OK to approve a one-time 15% credit buffer against the sandbox account for DEAL-4821. Please note this should not be treated as precedent — document the ask in the deal record.

Conditions:
- Extension: +7 days from current sandbox expiry (new expiry 2027-07-02).
- Buffer: 15% token credit, non-refundable, applies only to the current POC workspace.
- We require the milestone plan (one pager) filed in HubSpot and a quick post-mortem if the connector fix touches our data-handling guidance.

Mina — I'll mark the approval in the internal approvals tracker and attach our standard confirmation to the HubSpot deal. Laura — can you prepare the confirmation email (including the new expiry and credit stub) once we have the milestone doc?

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Priya Sethi <priya@novusinsights.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Rios <diego.rios@novusinsights.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — deployment connector teething issues

Thanks Mina and Marcus — we appreciate the quick turnaround and the buffer.

Attached is the one-page milestone plan and timeline: fixes scheduled for 6/23 (infra patch deploy), retest 6/24 morning, and a full end-to-end run on 6/25. We're optimistic this will keep our demo window intact.

We accept the credit buffer and the extension. We'll file the post-mortem within 10 business days after the retest.

See you on Friday for the demo.

Best,
Priya Sethi
CTO, Novus Insights

Attachments: proposed-milestones.xlsx (spreadsheet)
